layerSeparation.runtimeSemanticClaim: For ordinary non-DataExchange.Load SalesInvoice writes with VATWithholding=false and ExemptFromVAT=false, every persisted Inventory row has Amount, VATAmount, and Total consistent with the existing calculation semantics; header Total is the sum of those persisted normalized row totals; posting consumes the normalized values.
layerSeparation.boundedPatchPolicy: The candidate source change must traverse the complete Inventory collection and reuse InventoryTabularSectionClientServer.CalculateAmount(row, VATWithholding) before the existing header summation. It must not hard-code positions, VAT cases, cardinalities, or add unrelated control flow.
layerSeparation.nonEquivalenceStatement: Runtime observations and source policy are separate evidence. Exact For Each syntax is not a semantic observation and is not required for behavioral equivalence. An equivalent complete-collection iteration can satisfy behavior; source review separately establishes complete traversal and helper reuse.

vatScope.experimentallyClaimed: VATWithholding=false and ExemptFromVAT=false only, with VAT rates 0 and 20 in the frozen cases.
vatScope.notExperimentallyClaimed: VATWithholding=true, ExemptFromVAT=true, and other VAT combinations.
vatScope.safetyConstraintBeyondClaim: The candidate still passes the document VATWithholding value into the existing helper and adds no VAT-specific branch, but this source property is not presented as runtime proof for untested VAT modes.

evidenceInterpretation.warning: Inventory/cost algorithms are existing unrelated behavior. Their exact vectors detect regression but are not part of the new derived-amount business oracle.

runtimeMatrixAmendment.claimLimit: The two cardinalities/orders materially distinguish named positional shortcuts and prove correct-row preservation inside mixed shapes. They do not mathematically enumerate all cardinalities; collection-wide coverage is additionally established by source review of complete traversal.

required: The normal non-DataExchange BeforeWrite path traverses the complete Inventory collection exactly once for normalization.
Each visited row is passed to InventoryTabularSectionClientServer.CalculateAmount(row, VATWithholding) before the existing header Total summation.
No hard-coded row index/position, VAT-rate branch, cardinality restriction, inline replacement formula, or alternate normalization entry point is added.
